column1: # prices.tsv — API list prices for `agents report`'s API-equivalent cost.
# US dollars per million tokens, from the vendors' own pages:
# tuidev owns this file and replaces it on every install: to change or add a
# by default), whose lines are read after these. Format: one model per line,
# tab- or space-separated, # starts a comment:
#   MODEL_PREFIX  IN  CACHE_WRITE_5M  CACHE_WRITE_1H  CACHE_READ  OUT
# A model takes the longest prefix that names it up to a version boundary:
# the prefix itself, or followed by a date (-20251001, -2025-10-01), a
# openai/) are dropped first. So claude-opus-4-8 never takes claude-opus-4's
# price, nor gpt-5.7 gpt-5's. A prefix ending in - or . names a family
# (claude-opus- would take any opus without a closer line). OpenAI has no
# one-hour cache tier: its CACHE_WRITE_1H repeats its 5-minute price. A
# model without a line shows as unpriced, never $0.
# Anthropic                    in     w5m    w1h    read   out
# OpenAI                       in     w5m    w1h    read   out
